visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a white collared shirt, sits at a desk with a professional microphone. Behind her is a red neon sign with the characters "理科" and shelves containing small toys. She speaks directly to the camera with an engaging expression and frequent hand gestures. (2) An educational graphic is superimposed on the screen showing the biochemical pathway of Tryptophan converting to Serotonin and then Melatonin, featuring chemical structures and icons of a brain and the sun. (3) The scene transitions to a montage of food preparations: white milk is poured into a glass, a salmon fillet is shown cooking in a pan, a spoon scoops yellow soybeans, and a hand scoops rolled oats from a glass jar. (4) The woman returns to the frame, continuing her explanation about nutrient absorption and the blood-brain barrier. (5) A close-up shot shows a hand using a knife to slice a yellow banana on a wooden cutting board. (6) The video concludes with the woman summarizing her advice, looking directly at the camera with her hands resting on the desk.
